I2.18    Welding

         I2.18.1 All welding within ice-strengthened areas is to be of the double continuous type.

unchecked.reason: UR I1 is not referenced by the welding requirement (I2‑066) and does not affect the SHACL representation.
The essential welding clause (E497) is present; the missing portions of UR I2 do not impact the captured requirement.
The omitted passages of UR I2 are unrelated to the welding rule and therefore do not affect the SHACL validation.
UR I3 is not cited in the current requirement; its absence is irrelevant to the welding validation.
PR 29 is not required for modelling the welding requirement and its missing document does not impact the SHACL.

structural_change_manifest.diff:
--- v1
+++ v2
@@ -1,14 +1,17 @@
-@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
+@prefix sh:   <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
 @prefix vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
-@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
-@prefix ex: <http://example.org/shacl#> .
+@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
+@prefix ex:    <http://example.org/shacl#> .
 
 # -----------------------------------------------------------------
 # Shape that captures the welding requirement for weld entities.
+# It is **not** a target shape; it is only invoked from the ship shape
+# via the hasWeld property (see ex:ShipShape below).  This respects the
+# admission boundary which declares the population owner class as
+# https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ship.
 # -----------------------------------------------------------------
 ex:WeldRequirementShape
     a sh:NodeShape ;
-    sh:targetClass vocab:weld ;
     ## Requirement: if a weld is within an ice‑strengthened area,
     ## then its weld type must be the double continuous weld.
     ## Expressed as: ( NOT withinIceStrengthenedArea ) OR ( weldType = doubleContinuousWeld )
@@ -37,6 +40,8 @@
 # -----------------------------------------------------------------
 # Ship shape that links ships to their welds and enforces the weld
 # requirement on each associated weld.
+# The target class is exactly the declared owner class, satisfying the
+# admission scope constraint.
 # -----------------------------------------------------------------
 ex:ShipShape
     a sh:NodeShape ;
